means.idiom-jp: (人)と一緒にいる、(人)の相手をする；(話など)に付き合う
means.example-sentence: She asked me to keep her company until her parents came home.
means.sentence-jp: 彼女は私に両親が帰宅するまで彼女と一緒にいてほしいと頼んだ。

cloze.maskedText: She asked me to ____ until her parents came home.

notes: in 〜's company, in the company of ~, in company with ~ は「〜と一緒に」(= with ~) の意味。
